To Rack. This Property sign from CGAP Safety reads: RETURN BUCKETS / TO RACK. Written for driving ranges, mini golf and family fun centers.

Why this sign matters

Sets the rule for your property in plain words, so drivers and visitors know it before they park, enter or use the space.

Where to post it

At the range bucket return.

Who orders it

Owners and managers.

Rust-resistant .065 aluminum, UV-resistant print, pre-drilled in all four corners. Made in the USA. A sign supports your site rules; it does not replace training or supervision.
